title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is the end of section 129) of the Longue Marche continuation (manuscript pp. 707–708). The previous page sets up the situation. G^+ is an extension of H^+ by an abelian group M, written additively and generated by λ_0, λ_1, λ_∞ with λ_0+λ_1+λ_∞ = 0. A particular solution of the linear condition (273) is chosen: a_1 = b = 0, a_0 = 1. This gives a splitting with new generators ρ' = λ_0 ρ and σ' = σ (274). Elements μ of a group of units, written 𝕆_12^* (possibly something like (ℤ/12)^*), are lifted to automorphisms u'_μ of G_{ρ,σ}/μ_G, or of G_{ρ,σ} for a subgroup marked with a double prime. These lifts satisfy (276): u'_μ fixes ρ' and σ', and acts on M through the character μ = χ(μ).

This page draws the consequence (277) for the original generators: u'_μ(ρ) = λ_0^{-2ν} ρ and u'_μ(σ) = ω^{1/2} σ, where ν = ν(μ). The parenthetical says the second formula reduces to σ in the quotient G_{ρ,σ}/μ_G.

The first formula checks out in additive notation. Since ρ = λ_0^{-1} ρ', we get u'(ρ) = u'(λ_0)^{-1} ρ' = λ_0^{-μ} λ_0 ρ = λ_0^{1-μ} ρ. This equals λ_0^{-2ν} ρ provided χ(μ) = 1 + 2ν(μ). That relation is presumably what ν(μ) means in the earlier formula (151), which is not visible here. The factor ω^{1/2} is a central element of μ_G, which explains why it disappears modulo μ_G.

The point of the computation is to describe explicitly how this group of units (a cyclotomic/Galois-type symmetry) acts on the abelianized level of the fundamental group extension of the projective line minus three points / M_{0,4}. This prepares the 'Retour sur la tour de Fermat' of section 130 on the next page. The page itself is a routine one-line bookkeeping computation.
errors: The first formula is consistent only if χ(μ) = 1 + 2ν(μ). This cannot be verified from this page alone (ν is defined in earlier formula (151)), but the computation is otherwise coherent.

ideas.what: Explicit action of a lifted unit automorphism u'_μ on the original generators ρ, σ after changing the splitting (ρ' = λ_0 ρ)
ideas.modern_name: Explicit Galois/outer action on metabelian quotients of π_1(P^1 − {0,1,∞}); conjugation by a cocycle when changing the splitting of an extension
ideas.usually_credited_to: Metabelian Galois representations / Fermat tower: Ihara (1980s), Anderson, Coleman; general Grothendieck–Teichmüller framework from Esquisse/Longue Marche
ideas.where_published: La Longue Marche (1981) and its continuation are unpublished manuscripts; this particular formula is not known in print

deep.surprise_reason: A two-line routine consequence of the preceding computation (formula 277), with no new idea of its own. It belongs to the metabelian/Fermat-tower analysis that Ihara and others developed independently.
transcription_corrections: The first word is 'et' (the transcription is fine): 'et ... on déduit aussi'.
In the second line the subscript should be the underlined μ, i.e. u'_{\underline{\mu}}(σ) = ω^{1/2} σ, consistent with the first line.
The parenthetical reads '(= σ dans \underline{G}_{ρ,σ}/μ_G ...)' with μ_G as a subscripted group, not 'μG'.
